_about: Where to look for jobs. type feeds = company boards listed in companies.json, read automatically by engine/scan.py. type browser = a site your AI agent searches in your own logged-in browser (tasks/browse-search.md); jobs it finds go to data/inbox/ and scan.py imports them through the same filters. Add, remove or set enabled=false freely.

sources.name: Company job boards (companies.json)
sources.notes: Fastest and most reliable source: no browser needed.

sources.name: Naukri
sources.notes: India's largest job site. Logged in, results include recruiter activity and the 'apply on company site' links.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.notes: LinkedIn's terms forbid automated scraping and accounts can be restricted. If you enable it, keep to a few searches at a human pace in your own session. Never use Easy Apply through the agent.

sources.name: Indeed India
sources.notes: Often shows CAPTCHAs to automated browsing; the agent stops and asks you when one appears.
